heading_en: Treatment of Delta Risk and Curvature Risk for Products with Multiple Underlying Assets
summary_ja: 複数の原資産を有する商品のデルタ・リスク及びカーベチャー・リスクにルックスルー・アプローチを用いることを原則とし、その留意事項、例外の要件及び例外時の算出方法を定める。
summary_en: Requires the look-through approach for delta and curvature risk of products with multiple underlying assets, and sets the points to note, the requirements for the exception for listed equity or credit indices, and the method used where look-through is not applied.
paragraphs: In calculating the market risk equivalent amount for delta risk and curvature risk relating to products with multiple underlying assets, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall use the look-through approach (meaning a method of calculating the market risk equivalent amount by regarding the assets as directly held and identifying the constituent assets; the same applies below).

In using the look-through approach, the following matters shall be noted. (i) For index products that are securitization products (CTP), the product shall be treated as a single risk factor, and sensitivities shall not be offset at the issuer level. (ii) A consistent method shall be used for each index product.

Where the market risk equivalent amount for index products other than securitization products (CTP), and for options with multiple underlying assets, is calculated using the look-through approach, sensitivities to the risk factors of the constituents of the index product or option may be offset against sensitivities to single names.

Notwithstanding paragraph (1), for a product that references a listed equity index or credit index, where all of the following requirements are satisfied, the market risk equivalent amount may be calculated as provided in the following paragraph. (i) The constituent assets can be identified. (ii) The index consists of 20 or more constituents. (iii) The proportion of the value of any one constituent of the index product in the value of the entire index product is less than 25%. (iv) The proportion of the value of the top 10% of the constituents of the index product, by value, in the value of the entire index product is less than 60%. (v) The total value of the constituents of the index product is 40 billion US dollars or more.

Where the look-through approach is not used under the preceding paragraph in calculating the market risk equivalent amount for delta risk and curvature risk, the market risk equivalent amount shall be calculated as provided below. (i) A single sensitivity shall be used for each index benchmark that is generally traded in the market. (ii) The sensitivity to the index product shall be classified into the bucket prescribed in (a) or (b) below according to the following cases. (a) Where more than 75% of the constituents of the index product are classified into a particular sector bucket (meaning a bucket falling under any of bucket numbers 1 through 16 in the table in Article 263-3, paragraph (1), item (i) and any of bucket numbers 1 through 11 in the table in Article 264, paragraph (1), item (i); the same applies below in this (a) and in Article 262-3, item (ii)(a)): that particular sector bucket. (b) In cases other than (a): the bucket with bucket number 17 or 18 in the table in Article 263-3, paragraph (1), item (i), and the bucket with bucket number 12 or 13 in the table in Article 264, paragraph (1), item (i).
